svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="process-view-level-4-help-request" name="process-view-level-4-help-request"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor P as Participant (P1)
 participant S as Help request page (web app)
 participant C as API client (web app)
 participant GW as API gateway
 participant CT as REST controller (Reports)
 participant TC as Triage consumer (Reports)
 participant UC as Use cases (Reports)
 participant AC as AI client (Reports)
 participant AI as AI provider (Ollama)
 participant DB as Reports DB
 participant OB as Outbox publisher (Reports)
 participant MQ as RabbitMQ
 P->>S: Fills in category, location, optional text
 S->>C: Submit help request
 C->>GW: POST help request [HTTPS/JSON]
 GW->>CT: Validate JWT, rate limit (5 per 10 min), forward
 CT->>UC: Submit help request
 UC->>UC: Validate, create HelpRequest \"Awaiting triage\"
 UC->>DB: One transaction (repositories): save HelpRequest and outbox row
 UC-->>CT: Request id
 CT-->>C: 201 Created
 C-->>S: Request received
 S-->>P: Shows \"Request received\"
 loop Every 1 s
 OB->>DB: Read pending outbox rows (repositories)
 OB->>MQ: Publish \"help request submitted\", request id only [AMQP]
 OB->>DB: Mark outbox row as published
 end
 MQ->>TC: Deliver event (at least once)
 TC->>DB: Was this message_id processed? (repositories)
 alt Duplicate
 TC->>MQ: Acknowledge and ignore
 else New message
 TC->>UC: Triage help request (request id)
 UC->>DB: Read HelpRequest by its id (repositories)
 UC->>AC: Get triage suggestion
 AC->>AI: Request [HTTPS, timeout, retries, circuit breaker]
 alt Suggestion in time
 AI-->>AC: Category and priority
 AC-->>UC: TriageSuggestion
 UC->>DB: One transaction (repositories): save TriageSuggestion and message_id
 else Timeout or error after retries
 AC-->>UC: No suggestion
 UC->>DB: One transaction (repositories): mark request \"Not triaged\", save message_id
 end
 UC-->>TC: Done
 TC->>MQ: Acknowledge
 else Processing fails (e.g. database unavailable)
 TC->>MQ: Reject, 4 attempts with backoff 1 s, 2 s, 4 s
 MQ->>MQ: Then dead-letter queue: alert, moved back by hand
 end
 Note over P,MQ: The operator's request list is read by polling, as in level 3
",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
